row.evidence: HiBob's pricing page says pricing 'is customized based on your company’s size, needs, and the modules you choose', and no public HiBob page documents an inbound SCIM endpoint; only Okta's catalogue shows a 'bob' app tagged SCIM with Create and Update.
row.notes: Status changed from June 'free' to 'unknown'. June's 'native SCIM 2.0 on all plans, SSO required first' has no public first-party source: help.hibob.com (where HiBob's setup guides live) returns 403/401 to anonymous visitors, the public developer docs (apidocs.hibob.com, llms.txt indexes and sitemap) contain no SCIM resources, and the pricing page names no plans or SCIM. HiBob is an HR source of truth: its JumpCloud integration is an outbound sync configured in Bob that creates and deprovisions users in JumpCloud, and Aquera's Okta connectors import users from Bob. Okta's own 'bob' OIN app has SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Attribute Sourcing checked but not Deactivate (read from page markup); the direction of that SCIM connection is not documented publicly, so it is recorded but not used for status. June's '~$10-15/emp/mo typical' figure has no first-party source and was dropped; HiBob only says pricing is per employee and quote-based, with Core included in every plan. The June pricing URL /pricing/ now redirects to a demo-request form, so pricing_page_url moved to /pricing-plans/. The Public API (service users, per-endpoint permission groups) can create, update, terminate, invite and revoke Bob access for employees; no plan gate is published for it.

plans.name: Core (custom quote)
plans.notes: HiBob publishes no tier names or prices; every plan includes Core HR, with modules added on top.

limitations.text: HiBob's outbound JumpCloud integration is called a 'SCIM Integration' but is configured in Bob and pushes users into JumpCloud; it is not an inbound SCIM endpoint on Bob.

auth.notes: Access is controlled by permission groups assigned to the service user rather than OAuth scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Read company employee fields by employee ID
Invite an employee with a welcome wizard ID
Revoke access to Bob for an employee

rate_limits.text: Per-endpoint limits per minute, e.g. /v1/people/search allows 50 requests per minute; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: A new service-user permission group has no permissions by default; each data category must be granted.

okta.notes: OIN 'bob' app: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Attribute Sourcing checked; Deactivate, Group Push and SWA not checked (read from page markup). Whether Create/Update writes into Bob or sources from Bob is not documented publicly. Aquera also lists two third-party connectors that import users from Bob into Okta.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com hibob-tutorial, bob-tutorial and the provisioning variants return 404.

jumpcloud.notes: Provisioning runs from Bob into JumpCloud (HR-driven), configured and supported by HiBob; nothing is provisioned into Bob.

fallbacks.other_sync: HR source of truth: outbound provisioning from Bob to JumpCloud (configured in Bob); third-party Aquera connectors import Bob users into Okta

open_questions: Does Bob expose an inbound SCIM endpoint (as Okta's 'bob' app suggests), and on which plans? HiBob's help centre is not publicly reachable.
Which HiBob plans include SAML SSO is not published.
Whether the Public API is included in every plan is not stated.
